hypothesis: Correcting the seventh-shop opening day may change marginal tomato investment decisions; it does not by itself establish a playing-strength gain.
single_mechanism: pending day 22 becomes day 21; existing 0.25 expectation and every other guard stay fixed
matches: each candidate versus its exact base on every seed and both seats; 48 games per base, 96 total
validity: official pinned interpreter; real unaltered shop RNG; hidden seed absent from agent input; independently reacting opponent; DONE/DONE; 719 calls each and 720 recorded states
no_trigger_rule: If no investment qualification changes and all action hashes match, report no behavioral evidence or strength gain and do not run an unnecessary promotion holdout.
trigger_rule: Any changed policy remains experimental. Compare both candidate and its frozen base against the independently reacting V38 v2 on this paired seed set before claiming any gain; unseen holdout is required for promotion.
negative_rule: Any regression is retained as evidence. Do not tune dates, probabilities, thresholds, or seed selection in response.
publication: return source diffs, builder, contract tests, runner, immutable identities and complete result JSON for the single research branch; no Kaggle submission
